reasons: Claimed status is 'compliant' and the cited paragraphs contain no non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant binding our party (Corio, the licensee/customer); the only 'Personnel' caption (Exhibit D §5) is a staffing-assignment obligation, and §13/§14 clauses cited concern IP ownership, employee NDAs and standard miscellaneous terms.

Consistent with the preferred position ('No non-solicit on Customer'), no redline or counterparty comment is proposed, and the rendered redline is identical to the originals — appropriate for a compliant finding retained as internal evidence.

The failed deterministic checks (12-month cap, general-solicitation carve-out) are fallback parameters that only apply where a restrictive covenant exists; their failure is expected here and does not indicate an error.

Rationale correctly flags the residual risk that the incorporated Non Disclosure Agreement and Statement of Work are outside this file and should be checked on the deal record, without overstating compliance.
